Mentored four engineers who now run the platform's weekly office hours.

bullets: Ran the PostgreSQL fleet behind the web shop, 30 clusters, with point-in-time recovery tested every month.
Introduced Prometheus and Grafana dashboards for checkout latency and stock updates.
Automated server patching with Ansible, from a full weekend of work to an unattended night run.

bullets: Built internal tools in Python and Go for billing reports.
Kept the build servers running and documented how to rebuild them from scratch.

cv.name: Aroha Ngata-Whitfield
cv.summary: Registered nurse with eleven years in emergency and cardiac care in New Zealand and Ireland. Calm in busy departments, careful with documentation, and used to teaching students and new graduates on shift.

bullets: Lead a team of 14 nurses on rotating shifts in a department that sees about 230 patients a day.
Rewrote the triage handover checklist; missed observations at handover fell by half in the next audit.
Coordinate bed flow with the patient flow team during winter surge periods.
Precept student nurses from two universities and sign off their competencies.
Member of the hospital's sepsis working group, presenting audit results each quarter.

Taught patients and families about medication and recovery before discharge.
Helped move the ward from paper charts to electronic observations.
Covered as shift coordinator on weekends.

roles.title: Graduate and Staff Nurse, Medical Ward
bullets: Completed the new graduate programme and stayed on as staff nurse.
Looked after up to six patients per shift on a busy medical ward.
Took part in the falls prevention project on night shifts.

cv.name: Tomasz Wierzbicki
cv.summary: Operations manager with twelve years in warehousing and road freight. I run sites where people know what is expected of them, stock is where the system says it is, and trucks leave on time. Comfortable with budgets, union talks and new warehouse software.

roles.title: Site Manager
bullets: Run a 40,000 square metre cross-dock with 180 staff over three shifts and a yearly budget of 9 million euros.
Cut picking errors from 1.8% to 0.4% by re-slotting fast movers and retraining team leaders on scanner use.
Led the move to a new warehouse management system without stopping outbound shipments for a single day.
Agreed a new shift pattern with the works council that lowered overtime by a quarter.
Set up a weekly safety walk; lost-time incidents went from eleven to two a year.

roles.title: Shift Lead
bullets: Planned daily loading for 60 trucks to Germany and Czechia, working with dispatch on late changes.
Trained new forklift drivers and kept the training records ready for audits.
Introduced a simple board for damaged goods that halved the time claims stayed open.
Covered for the site manager during holidays, including customer calls and staffing.

roles.title: Warehouse Operative
bullets: Picked and packed orders for retail customers, later promoted to team leader of eight people.
Kept the returns area tidy and processed returns within two working days.

cv.skills: Warehouse management systems, budgeting, shift planning, labour relations, lean, forklift licence
